package main
import("fmt";"strconv";collapse "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rules/tailwind/collapse")
func main(){
 if strconv.IntSize != 64 {panic("counter fixture requires Go int64 host")}
 for _,start:=range []int{0,9007199254740991,9223372036854775806}{
  for _,value:=range collapse.AdamicCounterSequence(start,3){fmt.Println(value)}
 }
}
